_tierLegend.A: Public ATS API confirmed reachable (Greenhouse/Lever/Workday CXS) — scripts/scan.mjs hits these directly, zero WebSearch cost.
_tierLegend.B: Known BFSI employer with real India tech footprint, ATS not confirmed as public JSON — reach via WebFetch on careers page or WebSearch.
_tierLegend.C: No usable ATS at all — LinkedIn/Naukri/WebSearch only.
_tierLegend.priorityNote: priority: 'low' means comp data or reputation signal suggests this employer is unlikely to clear 25 LPA at 2-4yr, or headcount is too thin to justify daily polling. Kept in the registry (don't delete) in case a specific req proves the estimate wrong — just poll less often / weight lower.

_atsAdapters.workday: POST https://{tenant}.{wdHost}.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs  body: {"appliedFacets":{},"limit":50,"offset":0,"searchText":"<keyword>"} — verified live 2026-08-09 for visa, mastercard, db
_atsAdapters.oracle_orc: GET https://{orcHost}/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList&finder=findReqs;siteNumber={siteNumber},facetsList=LOCATIONS,limit=20,offset=0,selectedLocationsFacet={indiaLocationId} — Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) REST API. The public careers.<company>.com URL is often just a vanity redirect to the real orcHost (a .oraclecloud.com or custom domain) — find it via curl -I on the vanity URL and read the Location header, or call the REST API directly on the vanity host first since some (JPMorgan, Akamai) proxy it through. indiaLocationId comes from the locationsFacet array in an unfiltered facets-only call (drop selectedLocationsFacet + expand). Job view URL = https://{orcHost}/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/{siteNumber}/job/{Id}. Verified live 2026-08-13 for American Express, JPMorgan Chase, ACI Worldwide, BNY Mellon, Akamai.
